# Quantum Blind Entanglement Purification

The fixed three-pair LOCC chiral Schur filter improves a common fidelity floor for independent two-qubit pairs with maximally mixed marginals and the same unknown dominant Bell eigenvector. Error strengths and axes may differ. A larger local cyclic block attains the optimal near-pure first-order infidelity factor 1/n for every fixed n>=3. The project includes exact isotropic formulas, counted recursion, circuit and finite-precision bounds.

Start at science/README.md, then read science/model.md, science/protocol.md, science/anisotropic-noise.md and science/near-pure-limit.md for the model and central results.

- Exact state/input/output/success conventions and inherited minimum specimen threshold: science/model.md.
- Physical local maps, complete instrument and unknown-target covariance: science/protocol.md.
- Equal/unequal-visibility contractions, gain and floor under classical product mixtures: science/algebra.md.
- Exact worst heterogeneous common floor, explicit orthogonal-axis example, and pooled-sign output invariant: science/anisotropic-noise.md.
- Arbitrary-map tangent converse, cyclic optimum for every n>=3, pure success and finite-noise qualifications: science/near-pure-limit.md.
- Optimization within paired rank-one multiplicity filters, including zero gain for real filters: science/chirality.md.
- All failed attempts, deterministic native-pair cap, confidence, achieved exponent, streaming storage, messages and elapsed-time upper bound: science/resources.md.
- Fixed local matrix, chronological gate compiler, unoptimized CNOT/one-qubit counts and precision convention: science/implementation.md.
- Complete flagged-channel errors, postselection conditioning, arbitrary nonisotropic implementation errors and final-noise limitation: science/robustness.md.
- Scientific consequence, why the physical target is preserved, and distinction from a known Bell channel: science/interpretation.md.
- Prior work and inherited proof/architecture: references/RELATED_WORK.md; structured citations: references/references.bib.
- Commands, expected checks and their limits: verification/README.md.
- Study route and the selected Nielsen–Chuang 2010 anchor: learning/README.md and learning/ANCHOR.md. The bridge translates fidelity, operations and target conventions and supplies a complete three-pair example.
- Common project understanding map: learning/MILESTONES.md, exactly M01–M30 in background and innovation phases. Follow its dependencies; the map contains conceptual targets rather than personal learner state.

Keep these distinctions explicit: squared-overlap fidelity versus half trace distance; per-attempt conditional output versus full finite-budget success; common quality floor versus best-input guarantee; pointwise product-mixture promise versus marginal floors; same unknown target versus known standard Bell output; specimen threshold versus memory lower bound; sharp fixed-filter heterogeneous envelope versus fixed-block near-pure optimum; arbitrary one-qubit gate count versus Clifford+T cost. The two-copy impossibility and Schur architecture are inherited and credited. No target drift or general quantum-correlated noise theorem is asserted.
